AnthropicSecret.Description: Example Secrets Manager secret payload for ops-monitor LLM config
AnthropicSecret.Name: ops-monitor/anthropic

Notes: Create with: aws secretsmanager create-secret --name ops-monitor/anthropic --secret-string file://secret.example.json
Only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is injected via ECS secrets in the CloudFormation template by default.
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / CLAUDE_MODEL can stay as plain task environment variables.
